FAQ

Why are your prices lower than average?

I'm building up my reviews on the platform, so early clients get a better price. The quality is the same — see the work above.

How many revisions are included?

Two full rounds within the original scope. New features are quoted separately.

How do I pay?

Through Freelancer.com milestones: the money is held by the platform and released only when you approve the result.

What time zone are you in?

Moscow time (UTC+3). I usually reply within an hour during the day and keep you updated in writing.
